item.title: 2. From git push to running pods — CI/CD anatomy, and the three bugs of PR 1494
item.description: The second half of the PR 1494 story: how a git push becomes running pods, what the deploy recipe does step by step, how container images and their tags really work, and the three genuine bugs found and fixed — a verify script that always cried wolf, a stale secret address, and a merge that produced a broken config.

item.title: 1. Kubernetes, Helm, and GitOps — the foundations under your Dagster platform
item.description: The conceptual ground walked while taking ownership of the helm-user-code PR: what Kubernetes actually is, how Helm charts work, what ArgoCD does all day, and how the team's two-owner split architecture hangs together — the corrected, final understanding worth reinforcing.
